title: 3 Simple Dance Moves for Beginners (Hip Hop Dance Moves Tutorial) | Mihran Kirakosian

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates three basic hip hop moves step-by-step, breaking down the footwork and counts. He then combines the moves together and encourages repetition for practice.
method.signature: He provides specific guidance on upper body posture and arm movement for beginners who usually feel stiff.

practices.what: Breaks down the first step counting to eight while demonstrating footwork and arm placement.
Repeats the first step multiple times with counts to build muscle memory.
Introduces the second step, focusing on staying in place and stepping out with one leg.
Teaches the third step involving a slide and drag motion with the legs.
Combines all three steps together sequentially into a full routine and repeats it.

beliefs.belief: dancing is all about your attitude, bending your knees, and giving it flavor
Learning takes repetition, and practicing steps over and over is necessary to overcome initial stiffness and lack of arm coordination.

moments.says: The teacher introduces himself, welcomes beginners to the tutorial, and explains they will be learning three basic hip hop moves.
The teacher addresses how beginners often become stiff and unsure what to do with their arms, suggesting clapping to keep the beat.
The teacher encourages the learner to keep practicing repeatedly until comfortable and invites them to leave comments for future moves.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable of mastering basic hip hop moves through steady practice and attention to rhythm and bounce.

struggles.theme: Watching from bed and not actually doing the moves
Feeling awkward or cringing while dancing alone
Feeling stiff and unable to dance naturally

clicked.theme: Found the step-by-step instructions simple and easy to follow
Learned a dance move easily despite thinking they had no rhythm

requests.theme: Ask for a complete playlist or series for beginners

meant.theme: Gained pride and confidence in finally learning basic dance moves
Older learners felt inspired that they are never too old to start

method.limits: Audio does not feature background music during instruction, only verbal counts.
